abstract: Is my IP network working? Although this seems to be a simple question, it is really difficult to define what working actually means. One approach is to build a model for a working system and then make measurements on the real system to see whether it behaves as expected. In a new technology area like SMPTE ST 2110 and ST 2059 (PTP—Precision Time Protocol), there are likely to be differences between reality and the model.
